hook: mod_wsgi's creator is building its Rust successor.

beats.say: Graham Dumpleton started mod_wsgi twenty years ago. His new project, Muru, is an AI-assisted Rust server for WSGI and ASGI Python apps.
He has published almost a post a day for three weeks, covering workers, HTTPS in development, Kubernetes, scaling to zero and in-page tracing.
His take: the AI does much of the surface work, but deciding what isn't good enough yet is still his job.
